name: dsh-overflow-fallback
description: 溢出兜底与续命：上下文超限、内置压缩放弃后自动再压一次并重试；仍失败时把原会话整理成交接包，在新会话接着聊。不换引擎、不加界面；续命默认显式触发，原会话只读。 · Overflow fallback and session revival for DeepSeek Harness: one last compaction retry, then continue the dead session in a fresh one with a handoff. No engine swap, no UI, original session read-only.

scripts.test: node test/decide.test.mjs && node test/plugin.test.mjs && node test/handoff.test.mjs && node test/service.test.mjs && node test/revive.test.mjs && node test/verify-install.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage test/decide.test.mjs test/plugin.test.mjs test/handoff.test.mjs test/service.test.mjs test/revive.test.mjs

author: WALZX123

dshhub.summary: 溢出兜底与续命：内置压缩放弃后自动再试一次；仍失败时生成交接包并在新会话继续。提供 overflowFallback 服务，供其它插件生成交接包、判断溢出失败。
